representative_contract.quantification: Every old live declaration that any Decl.Hsdecl merge can return in this invocation, including a previously inserted local candidate; the candidate itself is covered by the mapper derivation. Include every stored edge, unused saved value, key identifier, type and attribute reached from each returned object.
representative_contract.coverage_required: A complete initial Hsdecl representative projection or a source/process invariant, joined to the capture and every merge/return site. Establish closure under local insertions and weak clearing and exclude concurrent foreign insertions. A sample of returned objects is insufficient.

numeric_envelope_meanings.seed_saved_entries_per_formula: E: upper bound on the sum of saved-map entries in any returned old declaration formula before its downstream opening; count occurrences, including unused entries. The captured-root baseline of eight is independently included using max(8,E).
numeric_envelope_meanings.delayed_value_nodes: V: stored term occurrence bound for every seed saved value in that projection; include the captured six-node baseline.
numeric_envelope_meanings.type_occurrence_nodes: T: occurrence bound for every stored type, variable type and symbol signature, including unused saved values and map keys; include the captured size-three baseline.
numeric_envelope_meanings.attribute_universe_entries: A: cardinality of the union of attributes on all captured and selectable terms, symbols, variables and saved-map key identifiers; include the captured 80-attribute baseline.

required_invariants.requirement: Finite acyclic stored term/type graphs; valid bv_vars and bv_subst records, integer counts, identifiers and declaration caches. Fresh identifiers cannot collide with any projected key or variable. All semantic free counts are the actual counts of the opened terms.

Every seed saved value is binder-free, pattern-free and has at most one free-variable occurrence. Across all seed maps that can compose, no key with a non-leaf value occurs free in any seed saved value. Their entries and values obey E,V. Subsequent added entries are only fresh-variable renamings; independent validators restart from the immutable declaration.

After real opening and t_attr_copy, each selected logic body and proposition corresponds, modulo fresh alpha names, to the accepted refinement alternatives at that declaration index. Preserve types, constants, triggers, patterns, free-variable multiplicities and attributes used by notdef/notls. Additional guard exclusions may be represented as optional misses, but there may be no extra eligible body or hit outside the accepted 45-body/85-hit alternatives. Eligible bodies remain binder-free and pattern-free with formal coefficients at most one. Strict equality alone is not evidence for this requirement.

All stored logic/type symbols, including unused values and map-key types, belong to the captured validated symbol/signature universe. No extra hidden self-reference, alias expansion, recursive data dependency or signature variable is introduced. Types obey T, normalized Tyapp representation, signature type-variable bound two and application arity seven; attributes obey the union bound A. Environment constants retain builtin unbounded int behavior. No new named symbols/attributes arise.

Retain declaration index/kind/symbol, singleton nonrecursive logic shape, formal arities, d_news and validated cached fields. Opened root/body/trigger/binder/pattern coordinates lie within the accepted corresponding alternatives (not merely a global mass bound). Raw binder structure has no additional binders hidden in saved values; all patterns remain nullary constructors with empty variable sets. Reused ground Ddata/type/parameter declarations and their dependency graph remain the captured ones.

not_covered_by_this_contract: Unsuccessful Hsdecl collision comparands and their equality cost.
